nodes.n: First week of the season. You're not in the eleven. You're the twelfth man: drinks, towels, and Captain Kunal Sethi's spare gloves.

nodes.t: Small town. Two bananas, cut lengthways, not across. And my bat grip, the blue one, not the black one. Run.
Don't mind him. He talks to everyone like that. Except the mirror.
Jojo Fernandes. Leg-spin, Goa, your roommate. I snore in Konkani. Sorry in advance.
Rookie. Kunal wants you in the nets against Rawat. He wants to see you get hurt. I want to see you not get hurt. Pads on.

moment.title: The Rookie Test
moment.desc: Deepak Rawat, 148 clicks. The whole squad watching. The captain wants you embarrassed.Survive three balls.

nodes.t: Hm. Kunal, your rookie can bat. Bad luck.
Sonpur's finest. Bananas, small town. Lengthways.

nodes.n: Evening. The owner's box glows above the stands. Meera sits beside her father in white, not looking down. Not once.

nodes.th: Six days ago she sat on a sea wall with me until sunrise. Now she's a painting behind glass.

nodes.n: After training, at the bottom of your kit bag, a crumpled paper napkin. In eyeliner: "Gate 4. 11 PM. Come alone. M."

choice.d: She's the captain's fiancée. Your career is six days old.

nodes.n: You lie on your bed staring at the ceiling. At 11:20 you're running down the stadium service road in flip-flops.
Gate 4. A loading dock, a flickering lamp and a stray dog. She's sitting on a crate in a hoodie, with no earrings and no smile.

nodes.t: You came. Good. I needed to say thank you, and I needed you to forget that night ever happened.
Kunal's father owns half of my father's debts. This engagement is a business deal. If anyone finds out I ran, the deal dies, and my father with it.
Here. My old phone. My father reads my real one. If you ever need to tell me something, use this. Then never use it.

choice.t: "Then why did you run that night?"

nodes.t: Because for one night I wanted to be nobody. You were the only person in Mumbai who let me.

nodes.n: She pulls the hood up and walks into the dark. As the dog barks after her, a camera flash goes off somewhere in the stands above you.

nodes.cliff: Someone saw you. Someone has a photo.
